body.name: Standard order-compatible finite recursive structural causal model class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ord}}=\{(k,(\mathcal D_i)_{i=1}^k,\mathcal U,\nu,(\operatorname{pa}_i)_{i=1}^k,(\varphi_i)_{i=1}^k):k\geq1,\ (\mathcal D_i)_{i=1}^k\text{ satisfies finite discrete support},\ (\operatorname{pa}_i)_{i=1}^k\text{ satisfies order compatibility},\ V_i=\varphi_i(V_{\operatorname{pa}_i},U),\ U\sim\nu\}\).
